goal: Select the newest same-name check run deterministically by check-run id in prove_pr_and_checks, so an older cancelled run can no longer overwrite a newer successful one regardless of API row order (PR #2527 production refusal).
prohibited_actions: No database write or structure change of any kind
No change to any migration file or workflow file
assumptions: GitHub check-run ids are unique and assigned in increasing creation order, so the greatest id per name is the newest run of that check
A single same-name row needs no ordering evidence; only two or more rows must carry usable integer ids or the gate refuses
stop_conditions: Stop and report if any existing test proves the id-ordering assumption wrong for same-name check runs
Stop if the exact-head proof or the guarded-merge authorization check would need to change
